data.descriptionPlain:
About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Job Summary:
Want to make an impact by innovating how top global companies build teams and adapt to the Future of Work? As an Account Executive, you’ll have the opportunity to target and close net new accounts, as well as re-engage dormant accounts. Success in this role comes from your skills in researching potential customers, strategically engaging them, aligning Toptal’s value with their needs, and consistently closing new business. This is a full sales cycle role, which means you will be responsible for setting your own meetings through your prospecting and outreach.
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
Prospect, educate, qualify, and close leads and opportunities by engaging dormant accounts and performing lead-generation activities into new targeted accounts. Additionally, manage inbound leads, as required.
Conduct outbound prospecting via phone, email, and LinkedIn to convey Toptal’s vision, identify opportunities, present Toptal’s value proposition, and secure new business.
Effectively manage the sales funnel to optimize lead progression, coordinate communication among various stakeholders, and diligently follow up on accounts to nurture leads toward conversion.
As you become more comfortable in the role, you’ll help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics.
In the first week, expect to:
Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
Work with cross-functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success.
Learn the breadth of Toptal’s impact on the world’s largest companies.
Grasp the importance of the outbound function to the success of growing Toptal.
Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.
In the first month, expect to:
Complete our personalized sales training program, complete with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios.
Learn how to use outreach tools (SalesLoft, Zoominfo, SalesNavigator).
Learn the process for outreach, including calling, emailing, and LinkedIn messaging. Implement an outreach process and hit 1-month objectives.
Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers.
In the first three months, expect to:
While exercising discretion and independent judgment, uncover new opportunities with existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal.
Hit call/email quotas and fully ramped objectives.
Become proficient in using our SaaS tools.
Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com.
In the first six months, expect to:
Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives.
Assist with training and onboarding new Account Executives.
Build new and existing client relationships, expand Toptal’s partnership with new and existing clients.
Suggest, implement and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities.
In the first year, expect to:
Have closed multiple net new accounts from the strategic account list, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and how proper business development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue.
Consistently maintain a high level of success by meeting and exceeding 100% of monthly and quarterly key performance indicators and targets.
Establish a career path for advancement.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree is required.
The ideal candidate will bring at least 1 year of closing experience.
You are persistent. Being rejected by prospective clients can be a common occurrence in this role. You must have the ability to take those in stride and persist despite setbacks. Being enthusiastic, ambitious, and having a positive mindset will play a key role in your success.
You are naturally curious. You have a strong desire to understand people, their problems, companies, and industries. If/when you come across a complex issue, you can understand and explain them to clients.
You thrive with autonomy and ownership. We’re looking for someone who can be held accountable for leading their portion of the business. To succeed at Toptal, you need to be a world-class individual contributor. Part of this includes being able to take ownership of your accounts, successes, and failures.
You are a go-getter. We are looking for self-starters who are passionate about hunting for new accounts and think about target accounts as their own business. You aren’t afraid to do the work required to reach your goals by following a process and being creative.
You don’t take yourself too seriously; you have a sense of humor and are comfortable with sarcasm. This position does sit on our Sales teams, after all.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Experience in B2B or SaaS sales is strongly preferred.
Proven success in full-cycle sales, including lead generation, prospecting, running virtual sales calls, funnel management, and closing.
Proficient with sales tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator, with a demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technologies and adapt to evolving sales platforms.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
Work independently with minimal supervision.
Use all required digital collaboration tools.
Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.
US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt
This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to earn monthly commissions based on revenue generated from engagements sold. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. As an Account Executive, you’ll be responsible for driving growth by acquiring new clients, re-engaging former clients, and expanding existing high-value accounts to maximize long-term growth opportunities. Success in this role comes from your ability to strategically identify and engage potential clients, uncover their key business challenges, and align Toptal’s solutions to meet their needs. This is a full-cycle sales role, which means you will take full ownership of your pipeline, including targeting ideal clients, setting your own high-quality meetings, and driving the sales process through to close.

  • Effectively manage the sales funnel to optimize lead progression, coordinate communication among various stakeholders, and diligently follow up on accounts to nurture leads toward conversion.
  • Ensure timely and accurate CRM documentation, while providing leadership with clear sales forecasts and pipeline insights.
  • As you become more comfortable in the role, contribute to evolving our demand generation strategy and tactics to expand pipeline growth and market reach.

  • Suggest, implement and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities.

  • Have closed multiple net new accounts from the strategic account list, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

  • Minimum 2 years sales experience, including at least 1 year in a closing role.

  • Proven success in full-cycle sales, including lead generation, prospecting, running virtual sales calls, funnel management, and closing.
  • Proficient with sales tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator, with a demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technologies and adapt to evolving sales platforms.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You’re persistent in the face of setbacks, eager to understand people and problems, and motivated to go above and beyond to reach your goals.
  • You thrive with autonomy and ownership. We’re looking for someone who can be held accountable for leading their portion of the business.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

  • Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to earn monthly commissions based on revenue generated from engagements sold. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

·        10+ years of progressive leadership experience in scaling complex AI, technology or service organizations and multiple business units, ideally within technology-driven environments.

·        Experience at a technology, AI, or hyper-growth company is strongly preferred.

·        Exceptional strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions in ambiguous environments.
·        Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of influencing stakeholders at all levels, including executives and clients.
·        Experience driving cross-functional collaboration and alignment across Product, Engineering, sales, marketing, delivery, and support functions.
·        Excellent organization skills and detail-oriented. You are hyper-organized, know how to work efficiently, and prioritize execution, as well as mentor others to do the same.
·        Adaptable. Comfortable managing changing priorities, learning new skills, and building consensus across varied senior stakeholder groups.

·        Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.

·        Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.

·        Use all required digital collaboration tools.
·        Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Position Description:
As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineer team—its core to it.
You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turns technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down.
You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence.
You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing it off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency.
Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards.
You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal.
This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the details.
This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction.
AI and agentic engineering
Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against.
Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for.
Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed.
Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.
Team, resourcing, and accountability
Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.
Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.
Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows.
Platform and execution

This is a high energy, consultative sales role at inbound velocity where excellence will mean running a high volume of first conversations, asking better questions than the client expected, and constantly building momentum along the right Toptal offering path.
You will need to bring clarity and articulate value across Toptal’s full portfolio: specialized talent, global hiring and payroll through HireGlobal, and our AI-driven, platform-powered, outcome-focused services offerings.
Your ownership continues after the first call. You will represent the client through technical stages, keep them engaged between conversations, and resolve issues that slow a decision. You will manage those active opportunities alongside new incoming inquiries, knowing when to bring in specialists for deeper expertise.
Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by client service, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about how businesses work. If you want to build real consultative selling skills in a fast-paced environment and be compensated for it, this is the team you want to be part of.
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
Discovery and Diagnosis: You will run high energy, open-ended discovery on every inbound conversation. You will quickly establish rapport, understand what prompted the client to reach out, and uncover the business objective behind the stated request. You will use this to build the necessary sales momentum to keep clients engaged, earning the right to recommend before you recommend.
Qualify, Manage, and Win the Opportunity: You will quickly identify what is driving the need, whether there is a real opportunity, identify the metrics that matter most to the client, and who is involved in the decision. You will explain why the relevant Toptal offering fits, address the client’s concerns, and ask for commitment. You will manage deal cycles from discovery through close and maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in our CRM.
Own progress after the call: You will give any necessary specialists a clear account of the client’s needs and prepare them for subsequent conversations, stay close as technical questions are resolved, and keep the client engaged through the next decision. Maintain clear next steps, timing, and blockers for each active opportunity while responding to new inbound requests.
Portfolio Selling: Clients rarely arrive with their full set of needs articulated. You will be responsible for understanding the client’s broader growth plans, including global hiring, EOR and payroll needs, marketing and sales growth, financial, and technology challenges, and for positioning Toptal as a strategic partner rather than a single-transaction vendor.
Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will execute a client-centric approach across every interaction during pre-defined working hours, running rapid research on clients before outreach, asking focused questions to fill the gaps, and staying current on industry trends and the competitive landscape so that you bring a point of view to the conversation.
Collaboration: You will work with your team and with cross-functional partners, including matching, delivery, HireGlobal, and Toptal’s service offerings experts, to respond promptly to high-volume inbound inquiries and to bring the right expertise into a deal at the right moment. Communicating clearly over Zoom and Slack is critical.
Growth and Development: Our SMB team improves individually and as a team. You will review your own calls, seek and act on feedback, and contribute what you learn back to the team.
In the first week, expect to:
Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
Learn Toptal’s model, our team members, and our story.
Begin our 1-1 sales training covering our value proposition, discovery framework, sales process, and delivery method.
Become acquainted with the cross-functional teams you will work with to close new business.
Listen to recorded client calls and identify what the advisor did well and what they missed.
In the first month, expect to:
Complete our personalized sales training program, including mock calls and role-play scenarios.
Run an inbound conversation independently: identify the client’s need, explain the relevant offering and value proposition, handle common concerns, and ask for commitment.
Prepare clear briefs to bring necessary specialist teams into opportunities.
Begin closing new business, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
In the first three months, expect to:
Be fully ramped and integrated into the team.
Complete additional vertical-specific training.
Manage incoming leads alongside active opportunities, keep clients engaged through technical stages, and deliver against conversion and conversation-quality targets.
Maintain a healthy, accurately forecast pipeline moving through your funnel.
In the first six months, expect to:
Have a solid history of claiming and closing new business by consistently meeting or exceeding both sales and quality expectations and targets.
Identify where opportunities are losing momentum and improve your follow-through using evidence from your own work.
Suggest process improvement areas to increase team efficiency and effectiveness, which may include providing consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures.
In the first year, expect to:
Mentor new team members, helping them learn our model and pass along standard methodologies.
Demonstrate sustained sales and quality performance across initial conversion and continued partnership opportunities on inbound existing clients.
Be a reference point for the team on discovery quality and on positioning the full Toptal portfolio.
Become a productive, collaborative, and consistent contributor to the team.
Required Qualifications
2–3 years of B2B sales experience (Account Executive, Inside Sales, Sales Development, Account Representative, or a related role).
Demonstrated experience converting inbound opportunities into paying customers at scale, owning the sale from first call to close.
Experience coordinating parallel sales opportunities, and maintaining sales momentum while other teams complete necessary work.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Full availability during your working hours to take client calls.
Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company, managing a high volume of clients alongside competing deadlines.
Exceptional time management is key to success in this role.
Preferred Qualifications
Software, tech, or professional-services sales experience.
Exposure to a named sales methodology — MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar.
Experience selling more than one product or service line into the same account.
Familiarity with global hiring, EOR, or payroll concepts.
Fluency with modern sales tooling, including AI-assisted research, call review, and CRM workflows.
Core Competencies
Consultative discovery. You ask open-ended questions, listen for what is not being said, and diagnose before you prescribe. You are comfortable sitting in a question rather than rushing to a pitch.
Qualification discipline. You know the difference between interest and intent. You can articulate why a deal will close, who will sign, and what happens if the client does nothing.
Business acumen. You can hold a credible conversation with a founder or business owner about growth, hiring, cost, and risk — and connect what you sell to what they are trying to achieve.
Point of view. You bring insight to the conversation. You are willing to respectfully reframe a client’s thinking when their stated request isn’t the best path to their goal.
Client-centricity. You uncover and resolve client issues through value-based selling, and you are direct about fit when Toptal isn’t the right answer.
Will to win. You are naturally competitive and looking to exceed quota, not just meet it. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission, and we want our Client Advisors to make the most of it.
Learn-it-all mindset. You constantly seek feedback from peers and leaders, review your own calls, and share what you learn with the team.
Ownership. You operate as a self-directed individual contributor who takes full accountability for your pipeline and your results, while collaborating effectively with the cross-functional partners who help you win.

Demonstrated experience converting inbound opportunities into paying customers at scale, owning the sale from first call to close.
Experience coordinating parallel sales opportunities, and maintaining sales momentum while other teams complete necessary work.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Full availability during your working hours to take client calls.
Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company, managing a high volume of clients alongside competing deadlines.

Software, tech, or professional-services sales experience.
Exposure to a named sales methodology — MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar.

Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
Design, write, review and ship SQL models across our repositories that transform raw data into usable data products for all organizational stakeholders. Own and maintain the transformation layer.
Proactively work with the Data Engineers to ensure new data sources are added and available, and then modeled and published in our data warehouse.
Proactively monitor the data warehouse and extract insights to identify opportunities to improve data operations, data accuracy and quality, coverage, integrity, structure, and general usability.
Turn ambiguous business asks into modeled data. Run requirements gathering with stakeholders. Establish the grain, surface the edge cases, write down the business rules, and push back when the request would produce a misleading number.
Implement measures and processes to improve data quality, accuracy, coverage, lineage, access and retention across dozens of source production databases.
Own the data dictionary. Write table and column documentation that traces each field to its true origin. This documentation is consumed by AI agents as well as humans, and is an integral part of the semantic layer.
Diagnose and resolve data incidents.
Review your teammates’ code and provide feedback to maintain the hygiene of the data warehouse production environment.
Work closely with Business Analysts, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and business process owners to empower data-driven decision making.
Enable end users to better use data, understand complexities, nuances, and limitations.
Help make the team faster. Improve the agent playbooks, documentation, and tooling the team uses to work with the warehouse.
In the first week, expect to:
Onboard and integrate into Toptal, and begin learning our history, culture and vision.
Get your environment running end to end: GCP access, BigQuery, the Dataform repositories, and our agentic development tooling.
Shadow the teams whose data you will own to learn the core of Toptal’s operations and capabilities, including Growth, Talent Operations, Enterprise, and SMB.
In the first month, expect to:
Understand the data generated through company operations and activities and where/how that data is stored.
Understand our ETL processes, timing, tools, monitoring, roadmap, and pain points.
Understand our source systems, and where they fit into our business processes.
Start receiving and researching inbound data questions from Business Analysts.
Build your first Dataform pull request independently and start reviewing your teammates’ PRs.
In the first three months, expect to:
Develop a mastery of our core data elements and entities.
Begin standardizing definitions and creating SQL logic to push definitions into the data layer.
Be a first responder for data incidents, diagnosing root cause with evidence and a methodical approach.
Begin documenting data flows, definitions, calculation methodologies, and data elements to continuously build and improve the semantic layer.
In the first six months, expect to:
Contribute architectural ideas that impact our data environment and pipelines. Exercise discretion and independent judgment.
Be an integral part of the analytics team that ensures a world-class data warehouse service to our stakeholders.
In the first year, expect to:
Play a critical part in setting up the Business Analytics Center of Excellence for success.
Be the person the organization trusts about what a number means and whether it can be believed.
Have made the warehouse meaningfully more usable by both analysts and AI agents.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree is required, preferably in Engineering or a related technical field.
4+ years of experience in an Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, or Data Analyst role where you personally shipped production data models.
Expert-level SQL skills and a working knowledge of Python.
Fluency with LLMs and agentic coding tools. You already use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent as part of your daily working practice. You know where they are reliable, where they should not be used, and how to verify their output.
Experience with cloud data warehousing, such as BigQuery or Snowflake.
Good understanding of a modern transformation framework (dbt, Dataform, SQLMesh or similar). You understand dependency graphs, refs, incremental strategies, tests and environment promotion as concepts, not just as commands.
Git fluency. Branching, pull requests, code review, conflict resolution and generally working with a critical production environment.
Strong familiarity with orchestration tools such as Airflow, Cloud Composer, Dagster or Prefect. You can read a DAG, understand its schedule and dependencies, and find out why a task failed.
Process discipline. Jira, ticket hygiene, and code review etiquette. It’s mandatory you understand how to avoid shipping unverified LLM-generated code.
Experience in doing exploratory/raw data analysis, data modeling, and data governance (quality, accuracy, coverage, security, etc.).
Experience translating business logic and objectives into SQL code and linking data and analytics to business strategy and operations to drive real impact.
Familiarity with BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.).
Detail oriented, methodical, and thorough.
Team player who builds strong relationships and collaborates with others.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex issues in a simple and intuitive way.
Ability to work collaboratively and independently; take ownership of quality, accuracy, and timeliness of deliverables.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

We are looking for an experienced, strategic, and hands-on partnerships leader with strong commercial instincts, executive communication skills, and experience across partnerships, sales, services, and business operations.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Drive partnership revenue and pipeline: Build and execute partnership strategies that generate partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, accelerate sales opportunities, and expand revenue across Toptal’s services, products, and new businesses.
  • Own strategic partner relationships: Develop joint business plans with priority partners, build executive and field-level relationships, establish shared goals, and lead regular business reviews focused on revenue, pipeline, adoption, and growth.
  • Build joint GTM and co-sell motions: Turn partnerships into actionable sales motions through joint solutions, account mapping, co-selling, marketplace opportunities, reseller programs, sales enablement, campaigns, and events.
  • Grow Toptal’s position within partner ecosystems: Drive certifications, specializations, partnership tiers, designations, marketplace listings, and other requirements that increase Toptal’s access, credibility, benefits, and commercial opportunity within each ecosystem.
  • Secure partner investment: Identify and capture Marketing Development Funds (MDF), sponsorships, enablement funding, event support, sales incentives, and other partner-funded programs that can accelerate growth.
  • Manage the partnership lifecycle: Own partnerships from identification and business case through contracting, onboarding, launch, activation, growth, and ongoing performance management.
  • Coordinate cross-functional execution: Work closely with Sales, Services, Talent, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Product, and leadership to ensure partnership commitments are translated into clear owners, deliverables, and measurable outcomes.
  • Measure portfolio performance: Establish and track KPIs across revenue, pipeline, certifications, tier progression, partner engagement, co-sell activity, and partner investment, while maintaining clear visibility into priorities, blockers, and next steps.

  • Stay hands-on in execution: Personally develop partner plans, presentations, applications, business cases, enablement materials, and other work required to move partnerships forward and convert strategy into results.

  • Build context on Toptal’s partnership strategy, priority partners, current pipeline, and active initiatives.
  • Meet key stakeholders across Sales, Services, Talent, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Product, and leadership.
  • Begin transitioning ownership of priority partner relationships, operating cadences, and near-term opportunities.

  • Develop a clear view of the partner portfolio, including revenue opportunity, tier status, certifications, GTM motions, and key gaps.
  • Take ownership of partnership priorities, partner engagement, pipeline visibility, and cross-functional execution.
  • Identify immediate opportunities to accelerate co-sell activity, partner-funded programs, certifications, and tier progression.

  • Establish joint business plans and measurable growth priorities for Toptal’s most strategic partners.
  • Launch or strengthen partner-sourced and partner-influenced GTM motions, including co-selling, account mapping, enablement, marketplace, and joint solution opportunities.
  • Implement scalable processes and metrics for revenue, pipeline, certifications, tier progression, partner investment, and overall portfolio performance.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Demonstrate measurable commercial impact through partnership-driven pipeline, revenue opportunities, partner activation, and stronger ecosystem positioning.
  • Advance priority partners through certifications, designations, tiers, marketplaces, and other programs that expand Toptal’s commercial opportunity.
  • Establish a consistent operating rhythm across partner planning, executive engagement, pipeline reviews, GTM execution, and performance management.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Build a scalable partnerships function that is a meaningful contributor to Toptal’s revenue growth and go-to-market strategy.
  • Develop a portfolio of strategic partners with clear joint business plans, measurable pipeline and revenue impact, stronger partner tiers, and active co-sell motions.
  • Create the systems, relationships, and operating model required to continue expanding Toptal’s partner ecosystem across existing and emerging services, products, and new businesses.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 8+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, alliances, business development, professional services, sales, or related commercial roles, with demonstrated ownership of complex partner relationships.
  • Proven experience developing and executing partnership strategies that have contributed to pipeline, revenue growth, co-sell activity, joint solutions, or market expansion.
  • Experience working with technology, platform, cloud, AI, software, marketplace, or professional services partners is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships across both executive and field organizations and translate those relationships into actionable joint business plans.
  • Experience navigating partner programs, including certifications, specializations, tiers, marketplaces, reseller or co-sell programs, MDF, and partner-funded initiatives.
  • Strong commercial instincts and the ability to identify where a partnership can create meaningful value for both Toptal and the partner.
  • Proven ability to operate at both the strategic and hands-on executional levels, including developing plans, presentations, business cases, partner applications, and GTM materials.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to drive execution across Sales, Services, Talent, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Product, and Operations without relying on direct authority.
  • Excellent executive communication, negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience using CRM, pipeline management, analytics, and collaboration tools such as Salesforce, Google Workspace, Slack, and AI productivity tools.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

  • Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

 

This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to receive a discretionary bonus. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

data.descriptionPlain:
About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Job Summary:
As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will drive business growth by identifying opportunities with target clients. You’ll play a pivotal role in identifying potential customers, generating new business opportunities, and providing support to both customers and our team. You will set the stage for successful sales interactions through cold outreach efforts and nurturing relationships to secure qualified meetings for our sales team. If you’re a self-motivated individual with a passion for sales, we encourage you to join our team!
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
Sales: Understand current and future demand. Enable, educate, and directly support the sales force to best position this practice with Toptal clients and win new business. Lead client conversations, presenting Toptal’s perspective on innovation and experience topics, and ask exploratory questions to better understand client needs.
Begin the Relationship: Through lead-generation activities and cold-calling, you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop sales-ready leads and opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts. You will enthusiastically explain Toptal’s vision, pinpoint opportunities, and generate interest.
Client and Industry Knowledge: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. As the first point of contact for future Enterprise clients, you will be building rapport through strategic outreach and a well-rounded client and industry knowledge. Researching clients and staying informed on industry trends will be key to your success.
Collaborate with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team and Sales Executives to pursue opportunities, recommend appropriate follow-up actions, and schedule qualified meetings. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
Growth and Development: Our team has an aversion to complacency. We are always looking to improve both individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical success factors in this role and at Toptal. As you become more comfortable in the role, you will help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics.
In the first week, expect to:
Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
Work with cross-functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success.
Learn the breadth of Toptal’s impact on the world’s largest companies.
Grasp the importance of the SDR function to the success of Toptal.
Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.
In the first month, expect to:
Complete our personalized sales training program with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios.
Learn how to use Salesforce.com (our CRM) and other SaaS outreach tools (ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).
Integrate into your pod, partner with Enterprise Sales Executives and Client Partners, and begin targeting strategic accounts.
Learn the process for outreach, including calling, emailing, and LinkedIn messaging. Implement an outreach process and hit 1-month objectives.
Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers.
In the first three months, expect to:
Become fully ramped on the SDR team, attaining your metrics, which include calls, emails, and other sales activities.
Exercising discretion and independent judgment, uncover new opportunities within existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal.
Hit call/email quotas and fully ramped objectives.
Become proficient in using our SaaS tools.
Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com.
In the first six months, expect to:
Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives.
Assist with training and onboarding new SDRs.
Build new and existing client relationships, expand Toptal’s partnerships, and continue to execute account plans.
Suggest, implement, and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities.
In the first year, expect to:
Have built a portfolio of net new accounts from the strategic account list.
Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and how proper sales development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree is required.
1-3 years of experience as an Enterprise SDR.
Knowledgeable. Broad understanding of business challenges encountered by Enterprise clients.
Critical thinking. Critically think through the challenges clients face to create new opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts.
Perseverance. Be relentless and push towards your goal.
Passion. Enthusiasm and ambition to succeed in this role, as it can be difficult if you hate rejection.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

  • Have built a portfolio of net new accounts from the strategic account list.

  • 1-3 years of experience as an Enterprise SDR.

data.descriptionPlain:
About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Job Summary:
As an Enterprise Sales Executive at Toptal, you will be a key driver of growth within our AI Solutions business. In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise clients by helping them solve complex business challenges through forward-deployed AI solutions, AI software and platforms, AI services, and AI-enabled transformation.
You will develop tailored solutions that help clients move from AI strategy and experimentation into production, combining Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to achieve measurable business outcomes.
This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who have successfully sold enterprise AI solutions and are passionate about building a book of business from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and establish Toptal as a core AI services provider embedded in your clients’ most critical initiatives.
Enterprise AI has shifted rapidly from experimentation to execution. Companies are investing in models, agents, AI platforms, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled applications, but many are struggling to translate those investments into production systems and measurable business outcomes.
The challenge is no longer simply selecting an AI model or platform. Enterprises must identify the right workflows, connect AI to their proprietary data and knowledge, integrate existing systems, build and deploy agents and applications, establish evaluation and control frameworks, drive adoption, and continuously operate and improve AI in production.
Toptal brings together world-class AI and domain talent, forward-deployed solution delivery, AI platforms and capabilities, strategic technology partners, expert-in-the-loop operations, and managed services to help enterprises move from AI promise to production.
This role exists to convert that market opportunity into new enterprise relationships and position Toptal as a strategic partner for companies deploying AI across their organizations.
This is a remote position with significant client-facing fieldwork across the US. Applicants who reside within commutable distance of a major metropolitan area are strongly preferred. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
*The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts via identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time.
Net new accounts may begin with a specific AI initiative, workflow, platform implementation, or business problem requiring a disciplined approach to defining the opportunity and matching the right Toptal capabilities to the client’s needs. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units, workflows, technology platforms, and senior executive relationships.
These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, understanding the client’s AI and technology environment, aligning solutions to evolving business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level. Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account while consistently driving measurable client value and long-term growth.
Own and build a portfolio of enterprise AI accounts, with direct accountability for new logo acquisition, revenue growth, and client outcomes.
Prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities in close partnership with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), while expanding the relationships you establish.
Define and execute account strategy, including opportunity creation, pipeline development, and multi-year growth planning.
Lead AI solution development and deal execution in partnership with AI Services leadership, Industry GMs, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, Partnerships, and Delivery teams.
Partner with Client Partners to drive coordinated account expansion and maximize total account value as accounts mature.
Shape AI solutions that apply Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to clients’ most important business and operating challenges.
Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence to support accurate forecasting and informed decision-making.
Lead strategic conversations with prospective and existing clients, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
In the first week, expect to:
Onboard with Toptal and meet your TopPal.
Learn the core of Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our deep capabilities.
Familiarize yourself with the tools and resources needed to be successful.
Dive into our sales methods, our selling processes, and playbooks.
Become familiar with our contracting and legal methodologies, templates, tools, and processes.
In the first month, expect to:
Meet key Toptal stakeholders who will support your success and the success of the overall team.
Learn about the Toptal AI Go-To-Market Strategy, our key sales plays, solution portfolio, partner ecosystem, and client engagement model.
Work with AI Services leadership to establish a portfolio strategy and build account plans.
Shadow key calls and client meetings.
Begin to meet with clients, leveraging your existing enterprise AI network and relationships, to articulate Toptal’s capabilities and identify where we can help organizations move AI into production.
Begin prospecting and actively engaging target accounts within your portfolio.
Meet with SDRs, Client Partners, and cross-functional team members to align on joint account strategies.
Collaborate with Pursuits and Delivery teams to understand how we design AI engagements.
In the first three months, expect to:
Exercise discretion and independent judgment in the negotiation of contracts, work collaboratively with clients, and help them engage with Toptal’s AI capabilities and specialists.
Begin shaping AI solutions that resonate with your target accounts, including forward-deployed AI solutions, Outcome Agents, agentic workflows, enterprise data and knowledge solutions, AI platforms, and managed AI services, demonstrating your comfort and ability in working with ambiguity and directly innovating alongside your clients.
Establish credibility with client stakeholders through informed, consultative engagement tied to their AI priorities, business workflows, existing technology investments, and desired outcomes.
Own your pipeline and forecast with confidence.
Develop proposals and close your first set of deals.
Actively contribute to team rituals, best practice sharing, and win/loss reviews.
In the first six months, expect to:
Have an initial base of active clients while continuing to build your overall portfolio.
Expand your buyer network and deepen executive engagement across your accounts.
Drive net new opportunities by introducing additional AI capabilities, platforms, solutions, partners, and managed services and displacing incumbent providers.
Shape and influence client priorities, aligning Toptal’s AI solutions to critical business objectives and measurable, validated outcomes.
Execute against a defined growth plan tied to measurable outcomes.
In the first year, expect to:
Have built a list of incredible client accounts, advising them on how to utilize Toptal’s AI capabilities to address their priorities and key business challenges.
Establish and expand a strong executive network across your portfolio, building a foundation of advocates and sponsors.
Begin to mentor new members of the team, teaching them about Toptal, our AI model, and how to successfully grow their territory.
Be recognized for your subject matter expertise in enterprise AI solutions, leveraging your existing network and relationships as well as your proven consultative selling skills to drive meaningful results for your clients and the overall AI Services team.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree is required.
7-10+ years of experience in enterprise technology, AI software, professional services, or consulting sales, with a strong foundation in enterprise account development and complex solution selling.
Direct experience selling enterprise AI solutions is required, ideally including forward-deployed AI solutions, AI software or platforms, AI consulting and professional services, or managed AI services.
Extensive experience in consultative customer engagement and selling service-oriented, technology-enabled, or outcome-based solutions to enterprise clients.
Demonstrated success building a book of business from the ground up, i.e. self-sourcing, prospecting, and developing new enterprise relationships rather than relying on an inherited portfolio.
Proven track record managing a $5M+ annualized gross portfolio and closing $250K-$1M+ complex, multi-phase deals with enterprise clients with $2B+ in annual revenue.
Must be comfortable engaging C-level executives on how AI is changing their business, technology environment, operating model, workforce, and competitive landscape.
A well-rounded understanding of enterprise AI challenges and trends, including generative AI, agentic AI, AI applications and platforms, enterprise data and knowledge, models, workflow automation, governance, evaluation, controls, and managed AI operations.
Ability to have informed discussions about how AI moves from strategy and experimentation into real enterprise workflows and production environments, including the importance of context, data, integration, validation, governance, adoption, and ongoing operations.
Experience selling solutions involving leading AI, cloud, data, or enterprise technology platforms, and the ability to work in a platform-flexible environment across client technology ecosystems.
Exposure to hybrid talent models, forward-deployed delivery models, or alternative consulting delivery models.
Ability to build and execute account plans that lead to consistent portfolio growth and a healthy pipeline.
Proven success in collaborative prospecting, running virtual and on-site sales calls, and leading sales pursuits backed by a multidisciplinary team.
Experience negotiating complex service agreements with procurement and legal departments within enterprise accounts.
Ability to partner effectively across multiple internal teams to shape innovative solutions that drive client success.
Willingness and ability to travel to client sites, conferences, and team events (up to 25%).
Passion for solving client problems with creativity and urgency.
Regular or periodic travel to meet and engage with Toptal clients and customers both inside and outside of your geographic location.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

This is a remote position with significant client-facing fieldwork across the US. Applicants who reside within commutable distance of a major metropolitan area are strongly preferred. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

*The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts via identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one.   • Own and build a portfolio of enterprise AI accounts, with direct accountability for new logo acquisition, revenue growth, and client outcomes.
  • Prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities in close partnership with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), while expanding the relationships you establish.
  • Define and execute account strategy, including opportunity creation, pipeline development, and multi-year growth planning.

  • Partner with Client Partners to drive coordinated account expansion and maximize total account value as accounts mature.

  • Onboard with Toptal and meet your TopPal.
  • Learn the core of Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our deep capabilities.
  • Familiarize yourself with the tools and resources needed to be successful.
  • Dive into our sales methods, our selling processes, and playbooks.
  • Become familiar with our contracting and legal methodologies, templates, tools, and processes.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Meet key Toptal stakeholders who will support your success and the success of the overall team.
  • Learn about the Toptal AI Go-To-Market Strategy, our key sales plays, solution portfolio, partner ecosystem, and client engagement model.
  • Work with AI Services leadership to establish a portfolio strategy and build account plans.
  • Shadow key calls and client meetings.
  • Begin to meet with clients, leveraging your existing enterprise AI network and relationships, to articulate Toptal’s capabilities and identify where we can help organizations move AI into production.
  • Begin prospecting and actively engaging target accounts within your portfolio.
  • Meet with SDRs, Client Partners, and cross-functional team members to align on joint account strategies.
  • Collaborate with Pursuits and Delivery teams to understand how we design AI engagements.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Exercise discretion and independent judgment in the negotiation of contracts, work collaboratively with clients, and help them engage with Toptal’s AI capabilities and specialists.
  • Begin shaping AI solutions that resonate with your target accounts, including forward-deployed AI solutions, Outcome Agents, agentic workflows, enterprise data and knowledge solutions, AI platforms, and managed AI services, demonstrating your comfort and ability in working with ambiguity and directly innovating alongside your clients.
  • Establish credibility with client stakeholders through informed, consultative engagement tied to their AI priorities, business workflows, existing technology investments, and desired outcomes.
  • Own your pipeline and forecast with confidence.
  • Develop proposals and close your first set of deals.
  • Actively contribute to team rituals, best practice sharing, and win/loss reviews.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Have an initial base of active clients while continuing to build your overall portfolio.
  • Expand your buyer network and deepen executive engagement across your accounts.
  • Drive net new opportunities by introducing additional AI capabilities, platforms, solutions, partners, and managed services and displacing incumbent providers.
  • Shape and influence client priorities, aligning Toptal’s AI solutions to critical business objectives and measurable, validated outcomes.
  • Execute against a defined growth plan tied to measurable outcomes.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Have built a list of incredible client accounts, advising them on how to utilize Toptal’s AI capabilities to address their priorities and key business challenges.
  • Establish and expand a strong executive network across your portfolio, building a foundation of advocates and sponsors.
  • Begin to mentor new members of the team, teaching them about Toptal, our AI model, and how to successfully grow their territory.
  • Be recognized for your subject matter expertise in enterprise AI solutions, leveraging your existing network and relationships as well as your proven consultative selling skills to drive meaningful results for your clients and the overall AI Services team.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 7-10+ years of experience in enterprise technology, AI software, professional services, or consulting sales, with a strong foundation in enterprise account development and complex solution selling.
  • Direct experience selling enterprise AI solutions is required, ideally including forward-deployed AI solutions, AI software or platforms, AI consulting and professional services, or managed AI services.
  • Extensive experience in consultative customer engagement and selling service-oriented, technology-enabled, or outcome-based solutions to enterprise clients.
  • Demonstrated success building a book of business from the ground up, i.e. self-sourcing, prospecting, and developing new enterprise relationships rather than relying on an inherited portfolio.
  • Proven track record managing a $5M+ annualized gross portfolio and closing $250K-$1M+ complex, multi-phase deals with enterprise clients with $2B+ in annual revenue.
  • Must be comfortable engaging C-level executives on how AI is changing their business, technology environment, operating model, workforce, and competitive landscape.
  • A well-rounded understanding of enterprise AI challenges and trends, including generative AI, agentic AI, AI applications and platforms, enterprise data and knowledge, models, workflow automation, governance, evaluation, controls, and managed AI operations.
  • Ability to have informed discussions about how AI moves from strategy and experimentation into real enterprise workflows and production environments, including the importance of context, data, integration, validation, governance, adoption, and ongoing operations.
  • Experience selling solutions involving leading AI, cloud, data, or enterprise technology platforms, and the ability to work in a platform-flexible environment across client technology ecosystems.
  • Exposure to hybrid talent models, forward-deployed delivery models, or alternative consulting delivery models.
  • Ability to build and execute account plans that lead to consistent portfolio growth and a healthy pipeline.
  • Proven success in collaborative prospecting, running virtual and on-site sales calls, and leading sales pursuits backed by a multidisciplinary team.
  • Experience negotiating complex service agreements with procurement and legal departments within enterprise accounts.
  • Ability to partner effectively across multiple internal teams to shape innovative solutions that drive client success.
  • Willingness and ability to travel to client sites, conferences, and team events (up to 25%).
  • Passion for solving client problems with creativity and urgency.
  • Regular or periodic travel to meet and engage with Toptal clients and customers both inside and outside of your geographic location.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Become familiar with our contracting and legal methodologies, templates, tools, and processes.

Meet with SDRs, Client Partners, and cross-functional team members to align on joint account strategies.
Collaborate with Pursuits and Delivery teams to understand how we design AI engagements.

Exercise discretion and independent judgment in the negotiation of contracts, work collaboratively with clients, and help them engage with Toptal’s AI capabilities and specialists.

Develop proposals and close your first set of deals.
Actively contribute to team rituals, best practice sharing, and win/loss reviews.

Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As an Enterprise Sales Executive at Toptal, you will be a key driver of growth within our AI Solutions business. In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise clients by helping them solve complex business challenges through forward-deployed AI solutions, AI software and platforms, AI services, and AI-enabled transformation.

You will develop tailored solutions that help clients move from AI strategy and experimentation into production, combining Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to achieve measurable business outcomes.

This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who have successfully sold enterprise AI solutions and are passionate about building a book of business from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and establish Toptal as a core AI services provider embedded in your clients’ most critical initiatives.

Enterprise AI has shifted rapidly from experimentation to execution. Companies are investing in models, agents, AI platforms, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled applications, but many are struggling to translate those investments into production systems and measurable business outcomes.

The challenge is no longer simply selecting an AI model or platform. Enterprises must identify the right workflows, connect AI to their proprietary data and knowledge, integrate existing systems, build and deploy agents and applications, establish evaluation and control frameworks, drive adoption, and continuously operate and improve AI in production.

Toptal brings together world-class AI and domain talent, forward-deployed solution delivery, AI platforms and capabilities, strategic technology partners, expert-in-the-loop operations, and managed services to help enterprises move from AI promise to production.

This role exists to convert that market opportunity into new enterprise relationships and position Toptal as a strategic partner for companies deploying AI across their organizations.

This is a remote position with significant client-facing fieldwork across the US. Applicants who reside within commutable distance of a major metropolitan area are strongly preferred. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Shape AI solutions that apply Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to clients’ most important business and operating challenges.
Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence to support accurate forecasting and informed decision-making.
Lead strategic conversations with prospective and existing clients, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

Onboard with Toptal and meet your TopPal.
Learn the core of Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our deep capabilities.
Familiarize yourself with the tools and resources needed to be successful.
Dive into our sales methods, our selling processes, and playbooks.
Become familiar with our contracting and legal methodologies, templates, tools, and processes.

Meet key Toptal stakeholders who will support your success and the success of the overall team.
Learn about the Toptal AI Go-To-Market Strategy, our key sales plays, solution portfolio, partner ecosystem, and client engagement model.

Shadow key calls and client meetings.

Begin prospecting and actively engaging target accounts within your portfolio.
Meet with SDRs, Client Partners, and cross-functional team members to align on joint account strategies.
Collaborate with Pursuits and Delivery teams to understand how we design AI engagements.

Exercise discretion and independent judgment in the negotiation of contracts, work collaboratively with clients, and help them engage with Toptal’s AI capabilities and specialists.

Establish credibility with client stakeholders through informed, consultative engagement tied to their AI priorities, business workflows, existing technology investments, and desired outcomes.
Own your pipeline and forecast with confidence.
Develop proposals and close your first set of deals.
Actively contribute to team rituals, best practice sharing, and win/loss reviews.
In the first six months, expect to:
Have an initial base of active clients while continuing to build your overall portfolio.
Expand your buyer network and deepen executive engagement across your accounts.
Drive net new opportunities by introducing additional AI capabilities, platforms, solutions, partners, and managed services and displacing incumbent providers.
Shape and influence client priorities, aligning Toptal’s AI solutions to critical business objectives and measurable, validated outcomes.
Execute against a defined growth plan tied to measurable outcomes.

Have built a list of incredible client accounts, advising them on how to utilize Toptal’s AI capabilities to address their priorities and key business challenges.
Establish and expand a strong executive network across your portfolio, building a foundation of advocates and sponsors.
Begin to mentor new members of the team, teaching them about Toptal, our AI model, and how to successfully grow their territory.
Be recognized for your subject matter expertise in enterprise AI solutions, leveraging your existing network and relationships as well as your proven consultative selling skills to drive meaningful results for your clients and the overall AI Services team.

Bachelor’s degree is required.
7-10+ years of experience in enterprise technology, AI software, professional services, or consulting sales, with a strong foundation in enterprise account development and complex solution selling.
Direct experience selling enterprise AI solutions is required, ideally including forward-deployed AI solutions, AI software or platforms, AI consulting and professional services, or managed AI services.
Extensive experience in consultative customer engagement and selling service-oriented, technology-enabled, or outcome-based solutions to enterprise clients.
Demonstrated success building a book of business from the ground up, i.e. self-sourcing, prospecting, and developing new enterprise relationships rather than relying on an inherited portfolio.
Proven track record managing a $5M+ annualized gross portfolio and closing $250K-$1M+ complex, multi-phase deals with enterprise clients with $2B+ in annual revenue.
Must be comfortable engaging C-level executives on how AI is changing their business, technology environment, operating model, workforce, and competitive landscape.
A well-rounded understanding of enterprise AI challenges and trends, including generative AI, agentic AI, AI applications and platforms, enterprise data and knowledge, models, workflow automation, governance, evaluation, controls, and managed AI operations.
Ability to have informed discussions about how AI moves from strategy and experimentation into real enterprise workflows and production environments, including the importance of context, data, integration, validation, governance, adoption, and ongoing operations.
Experience selling solutions involving leading AI, cloud, data, or enterprise technology platforms, and the ability to work in a platform-flexible environment across client technology ecosystems.
Exposure to hybrid talent models, forward-deployed delivery models, or alternative consulting delivery models.
Ability to build and execute account plans that lead to consistent portfolio growth and a healthy pipeline.
Proven success in collaborative prospecting, running virtual and on-site sales calls, and leading sales pursuits backed by a multidisciplinary team.
Experience negotiating complex service agreements with procurement and legal departments within enterprise accounts.
Ability to partner effectively across multiple internal teams to shape innovative solutions that drive client success.
Willingness and ability to travel to client sites, conferences, and team events (up to 25%).
Passion for solving client problems with creativity and urgency.
Regular or periodic travel to meet and engage with Toptal clients and customers both inside and outside of your geographic location.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
Work independently with minimal supervision.
Use all required digital collaboration tools.
Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.
US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt
 
This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to earn monthly commissions based on revenue generated from engagements sold. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.
