In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise clients by helping them solve complex business challenges across a broad range of capabilities, including technology, marketing, and management consulting. You will develop tailored solutions that help clients accelerate strategic initiatives and achieve measurable business outcomes. This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who are passionate about building a territory from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value.
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts from scratch - identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time. Net new accounts typically involve mid-level stakeholders across one or two business units and call for a disciplined, transactional approach, matching skills to immediate needs with speed and precision. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units and senior executive relationships. These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, aligning to evolving client business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level. Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account, while consistently driving value and long-term growth.
Working closely with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), you will prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities while also expanding existing relationships.
You’ll operate in a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment, working alongside pre-sales experts and delivery teams to craft compelling, tailored solutions for each client.
Your initial portfolio will scale toward an annualized gross sales target of $1M in your first year, with expectations to grow into a $5M book by years 2–3, aligning with our broader portfolio strategies.
We are seeking scrappy, bold, client-obsessed professionals who are energized by face-to-face interaction, inspired by client success, and motivated to close high-impact deals. This is not a “work from your home office” role. We’re looking for professionals who are ready to get in the field, build lasting relationships, and lead with purpose.
In the first week, expect to:
Onboard with Toptal, learning the core of our model, our value proposition, and our deep capabilities.
Familiarize yourself with the tools and resources needed to be successful.
Dive into our sales methods, our selling processes, and playbooks.
Become familiar with our contracting and legal methodologies, templates, tools, and processes.
In the first month, expect to:
Work with your Portfolio Leader to establish a portfolio strategy and build account plans.
Begin to meet with clients, articulate Toptal’s capabilities, and identify where we can help organizations in your territory plan.
Meet key Toptal stakeholders who will support your success and the success of the overall team.
Learn about the Industry Go-To-Market Strategy, our key sales plays, and our client engagement model.
Begin prospecting and actively engaging target accounts within your portfolio.
Meet with Sales Development Representatives and Client Partners and cross-functional team members to align on joint account strategies.
Collaborate with Pre-Sales Solutions and Delivery teams to understand how we design engagements.
In the first three months, expect to:
Conduct research and outreach through multiple channels to uncover new business opportunities within your accounts and drive sales pursuits with cross-functional Toptal teams.
Exercise discretion and independent judgment in the negotiation of contracts, work collaboratively with clients, and help them engage Toptal’s engineering, design, and business specialists.
Provide consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures.
Provide advice and support for the planning of long term or short term business objectives or initiatives.
In the first six months, expect to:
Have an initial base of active clients, while continuing to build your overall portfolio.
Develop a network of client relationships and build a foundation of advocates and sponsors to expand Toptal’s partnership with existing accounts in alignment with your portfolio strategy.
In the first year, expect to:
Have built a list of incredible client accounts, advising them on how to utilize our talent network to build world-class distributed teams and increase efficiency.
Begin to mentor new members of the team, teaching them about Toptal, our model, and how to successfully grow their territory.
Continue to expand your portfolio of accounts, accelerate growth in your region, and use the full suite of capabilities that Toptal has to offer.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree is required.
Extensive experience in engaging and selling Consulting or Managed Services solutions, particularly within Financial Services or Professional Services organizations.
Proven track record in full-cycle sales of large, complex, multi-phase, managed technology projects to enterprise clients with $2B+ in annual revenue.
A well-rounded understanding of emerging technologies and ability to have an informed discussion about software delivery and development concepts with prospective clients.
Ability to build and execute territory plans that lead to consistent portfolio growth and a healthy pipeline.
Proven success in prospecting, running virtual sales calls, and leading sales pursuits backed by a multidisciplinary team.
Experience negotiating complex service agreements with procurement and legal departments within enterprise accounts.
Regular or periodic travel to meet and engage with Toptal clients and customers both inside and outside of your geographic location (25% or less).
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.
Essential Job Functions
Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
Work independently with minimal supervision.
Use all required digital collaboration tools.
Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.
US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt
This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to earn monthly commissions based on sales development results. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

This is a remote position with concentrated fieldwork across the US East Coast. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Why This Role, Now:
Consumer products and retail organizations are under pressure to move faster than their current operating models allow. AI has shifted from experimentation to execution, and companies across this sector are actively rebuilding how work gets done, across brand and marketing, commercial, supply chain, and digital commerce. Toptal’s CP&S vertical already partners with some of the largest consumer products organizations in the world on exactly this work.
This role exists to bring dedicated senior coverage to the US East Coast, where our client concentration and opportunity density are highest, and to convert that density into new enterprise relationships. You will report directly to the General Manager of the Consumer Products & Services industry vertical.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts via identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units and senior executive relationships. These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, aligning to evolving client business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level. Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account, while consistently driving value and long-term growth.
Own and build a portfolio of enterprise Consumer Products and Services accounts, with direct accountability for new logo acquisition, revenue growth, and client outcomes.
Prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities in close partnership with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), while expanding the relationships you establish.
Define and execute account strategy, including opportunity creation, pipeline development, and multi-year growth planning.
Lead solution development and deal execution in partnership with Industry GMs, Practice Leaders, Pre-Sales Solutions, and Delivery teams.
Partner with Client Partners to drive coordinated account expansion and maximize total account value as accounts mature.
Shape industry solutions that apply Toptal’s technology, marketing, consulting, and AI capabilities to the operating model challenges facing consumer products and retail organizations.
Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence to support accurate forecasting and informed decision-making.
Lead strategic conversations with prospective and existing clients, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
Your portfolio will ramp over your first 9-12 months, after which you will be measured against an annualized gross sales target of $10M, aligning with our broader portfolio strategies.

Onboard with Toptal and meet your TopPal.

Consumer products and retail organizations are under pressure to move faster than their current operating models allow. AI has shifted from experimentation to execution, and companies across this sector are actively rebuilding how work gets done, across brand and marketing, commercial, supply chain, and digital commerce. Toptal’s CP&S vertical already partners with some of the largest consumer products organizations in the world on exactly this work.

  • Drive net new opportunities by introducing additional capabilities and displacing incumbent providers.
  • Shape and influence client priorities, aligning Toptal’s solutions to critical business objectives.
  • Execute against a defined growth plan tied to measurable outcomes.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Have built a list of incredible client accounts, advising them on how to utilize our capabilities to address their priorities and key business challenges.
  • Establish and expand a strong executive network across your portfolio, building a foundation of advocates and sponsors.
  • Begin to mentor new members of the team, teaching them about Toptal, our model, and how to successfully grow their territory.
  • Be recognized for your subject matter expertise in the Consumer Products and Services industry, leveraging your existing industry network and relationships as well as your proven consultative selling skills to drive meaningful results for your clients and the overall industry team.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 7-10+ years of experience in professional services, ideally gained at a leading consulting firm, with a strong foundation in enterprise account management and solution selling. For instance, experience in a Director, Principal, or Client Service Partner role at a top consulting firm.
  • Extensive experience in consultative customer engagement and selling of service-oriented or outcome-based solutions, particularly within the Consumer Products and Services industry, with focus in the Retail, CPG, Food, and Grocery segments.

Consumer products and retail organizations are under pressure to move faster than their current operating models allow. Toptal’s CP&S vertical already partners with some of the largest consumer products organizations in the world on exactly this work.
This role exists to bring dedicated senior coverage to the US East Coast, where our client concentration and opportunity density are highest, and to convert that density into new enterprise relationships. Own and build a portfolio of enterprise Consumer Products and Services accounts, with direct accountability for new logo acquisition, revenue growth, and client outcomes.

Onboard with Toptal and meet your TopPal.
Learn the core of Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our deep capabilities.

Execute against a defined growth plan tied to measurable outcomes.

Demonstrated success building a book of business from the ground up, i.e. self-sourcing, prospecting, and developing new enterprise relationships rather than relying on an inherited portfolio.

Ability to build and execute account plans that lead to consistent portfolio growth and a healthy pipeline.

Work independently with minimal supervision.
Use all required digital collaboration tools.
Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

  • Exposure to hybrid talent models or alternative consulting delivery models.
  • Ability to build and execute account plans that lead to consistent portfolio growth and a healthy pipeline.

  • Willingness and ability to travel to client sites, conferences, and team events (25–40%).
  • Passion for solving client problems with creativity and urgency.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • High level of intellectual curiosity, grit, and entrepreneurial spirit.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.

  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

Define and execute account strategy, including opportunity creation, pipeline development, and multi-year growth planning.

Partner with Client Partners to drive coordinated account expansion and maximize total account value as accounts mature.
Shape industry solutions that apply Toptal’s technology, marketing, consulting, and AI capabilities to the operating model challenges facing healthcare and life sciences organizations.
Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence to support accurate forecasting and informed decision-making.
Lead strategic conversations with prospective and existing clients, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

Onboard with Toptal and meet your TopPal.
Learn the core of Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our deep capabilities.
Familiarize yourself with the tools and resources needed to be successful.

Become familiar with our contracting and legal methodologies, templates, tools, and processes.

Collaborate with Pursuits and Delivery teams to understand how we design engagements.

About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Job Summary:
Toptal’s inbound sales team is a driving force behind our growth, converting inbound interest from small- and medium-sized businesses into Toptal clients. As Manager, SMB Sales, you will lead a team of Client Advisors, coaching them towards growth and holding them to a high standard of excellence in a high-velocity, consultative selling role. You will keep the team responsive to new inquiries while ensuring active opportunities continue to move. You will coach advisors through stalled decisions, specialist involvement, and client follow-up, stepping in where your judgement can help secure the next commitment. You will lead a team that is responsible for executing strong discovery, disciplined qualification, portfolio selling across Toptal’s full offering with complete ownership of the client relationship from first conversation through close. Your team’s job is to position Toptal as a strategic services partner, not a single-transaction talent vendor, and you set that standard.
You will be accountable for improving conversion of inbound leads by identifying conversion leakage, bringing accountability to individuals’ performance, hiring Client Advisors with consultative potential, reviewing calls, demonstrating stronger approaches, and coaching each advisor on changes to improve their sales skill and industry knowledge. Internally, this position works closely with leadership across Client Services, Talent Operations, Client Experience, and People to support a team-based approach to best-in-class service.
Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by team success, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about what makes a sales team excellent. If you want to sharpen a team’s performance and be recognized for the results, this is the team you want to be part of.
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
Coach: Coach Client Advisors on discovery, qualification, portfolio selling, and deal management. Demonstrate how to bring a useful point of view, support recommendations with relevant proof points, address concerns, and ask for commitment.
Develop: Review live and recorded calls, examine active opportunities, and identify specific changes that will improve each Client Advisor’s results. Run focused role-plays, demonstrate stronger approaches, and give clear, actionable feedback.
Hire and Build: Recruit and interview Client Advisors against our Client Advisor Core Competencies, hiring for consultative potential - curiosity, business acumen, and coachability - as well as sales experience.
Playbook Ownership: Own and continuously refine the Client Advisor inbound playbook, using call audit findings and conversion data to keep it current and effective.
Manage Performance: Understand causes of underperformance and agree specific corrective actions and timelines with Client Advisors. Demonstrate sustained improvement in team conversion and sales performance, supported by stronger discovery, qualification, follow-through, and portfolio expansion.
Onboard and Ramp: Manage onboarding for new Client Advisors, ensuring they complete sales training and assessing each new advisor against the skill-based Client Advisor ramp milestones — running discovery unaided, qualifying a live opportunity, surfacing needs beyond the initial request — on the path to independent, quota-carrying performance.
Career Development: Support career development and succession planning for Client Advisors, including the path into leadership.
Pipeline Oversight: Challenge the evidence behind each Client Advisor’s view of an opportunity: why it may proceed, what remains unresolved, when decisions are likely, and use that judgment to improve qualification and prioritize support, and strengthen forecasting discipline..
Operational Excellence: Identify process improvements that increase Client Advisor efficiency, productivity, and scalability.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Work seamlessly with cross-functional partners that include, but are not limited to: Client Services, Talent Operations, Client Experience, and People leadership. Additionally, be able to bring in the right specialists (matching, delivery, HireGlobal, service-offering experts) at the right time.
Reporting: Deliver presentations to cross-departmental partners covering metrics, key takeaways, and action plans based on data analysis.
Motivation and Recognition: Motivate the team through recognition, incentives, and transparent communication of expectations and results.
Culture: Drive a culture of high performance, accountability, and continuous improvement within the team — including a learn-it-all habit of self and peer call review, and a library of strong calls that show the standard.
In the first week, expect to:
Onboard and integrate into Toptal leadership.
Learn Toptal’s model, our team members, and our story.
Become acquainted with the team members who will report to you.
In the first month, expect to:
Complete Toptal’s leadership/sales training program and build a deep understanding of who our clients are and how Client Advisors sell across our full portfolio.
Understand your team and their current performance levels, the SMB Sales Leadership and expectations, and identify the main causes of conversion leakage.
Begin 1-1 coaching with each team member based on ongoing live and recorded call reviews.
In the first three months, expect to:
Develop and roll out your strategy to increase team performance and productivity, with individual goals set for each team member.
Run consistent coaching and opportunity-review cadences with specific improvement priorities for each Client Advisor.
Deliver your first cross-departmental presentation covering metrics, key takeaways, and action plans.
In the first six months, expect to:
Demonstrate measurable commercial improvement in conversion and sales performance from Client Advisors being coached, supported by stronger call quality scores, opportunity progression, and qualified HireGlobal and services opportunities.
Regularly assess performance against KPIs, partnering with sales enablement and operations to continuously improve.
Continue building, coaching, and mentoring your team toward greater results.
In the first year, expect to:
Run an optimized, well-managed inbound sales function that maximizes Toptal’s ability to capture SMB market demand profitably.
Develop senior Client Advisors who mentor new team members and serve as reference points on discovery quality and portfolio positioning.
Sustain a culture of high performance, continuous improvement, and record-breaking results and client experiences.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree required.
Three or more years in business-to-business sales, featuring one to two years direct leadership of inbound, inside, or end-to-end small business sales teams.
Demonstrated record of improving individual and team sales performance through specific coaching, disciplined opportunity management, and clear performance expectations. Ability to learn and coach to a structured sales methodology.
Experience managing pipeline and forecast rigor across a team in a CRM. Genuine, demonstrable passion for AI in the world of work, including using AI to improve how a sales team researches, reviews calls, and coaches.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting metrics and strategy to cross-departmental partners.
Comfortable operating in a dynamic environment with evolving processes and priorities.
Full availability during working hours to support your team and step into client escalations as needed.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience leading a team that sells more than one product or service line into the same account (portfolio selling).
Experience with a named sales methodology (MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar).
Software, tech, or professional-services sales leadership experience.
Fluency with modern sales tooling, including AI-assisted call review, conversation intelligence, and CRM workflows.
Core Competencies
These are the skills we evaluate during interviews and continue to develop with you after you join.
Consultative sales mastery. You can run and model an excellent discovery call yourself — open-ended discovery, disciplined qualification, and a dated, named next step — and show your team what good looks like.
Coach-first leadership. You develop people through call review, role-play, and specific feedback, not just dashboards. Your team gets better because you are in the details with them.
Talent judgment. You can spot curiosity, business acumen, and coachability in an interview, and you can tell real potential from polish.
Insight-led selling. You can teach Client Advisors to bring a point of view, reframe a client’s thinking when needed, and position Toptal as a strategic services partner rather than a talent marketplace.
Accountable. You take ownership of your team’s results and hold your team accountable to raising their own bar.
Critical thinker. Strong analytical and problem-resolution skills, with a demonstrated ability to develop data-driven solutions.
Proactive, collaborative communicator. You drive toward the mission without being told, and you communicate clearly across your team, cross-functional partners, and clients essential in our remote environment.

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Coach: Coach Client Advisors on discovery, qualification, portfolio selling, and deal management. Demonstrate how to bring a useful point of view, support recommendations with relevant proof points, address concerns, and ask for commitment.
  • Develop: Review live and recorded calls, examine active opportunities, and identify specific changes that will improve each Client Advisor’s results. Run focused role-plays, demonstrate stronger approaches, and give clear, actionable feedback.
  • Hire and Build: Recruit and interview Client Advisors against our Client Advisor Core Competencies, hiring for consultative potential - curiosity, business acumen, and coachability - as well as sales experience.
  • Playbook Ownership: Own and continuously refine the Client Advisor inbound playbook, using call audit findings and conversion data to keep it current and effective.
  • Manage Performance: Understand causes of underperformance and agree specific corrective actions and timelines with Client Advisors. Demonstrate sustained improvement in team conversion and sales performance, supported by stronger discovery, qualification, follow-through, and portfolio expansion.
  • Onboard and Ramp: Manage onboarding for new Client Advisors, ensuring they complete sales training and assessing each new advisor against the skill-based Client Advisor ramp milestones — running discovery unaided, qualifying a live opportunity, surfacing needs beyond the initial request — on the path to independent, quota-carrying performance.
  • Career Development: Support career development and succession planning for Client Advisors, including the path into leadership.
  • Pipeline Oversight: Challenge the evidence behind each Client Advisor’s view of an opportunity: why it may proceed, what remains unresolved, when decisions are likely, and use that judgment to improve qualification and prioritize support, and strengthen forecasting discipline..
  • Operational Excellence: Identify process improvements that increase Client Advisor efficiency, productivity, and scalability.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work seamlessly with cross-functional partners that include, but are not limited to: Client Services, Talent Operations, Client Experience, and People leadership. Additionally, be able to bring in the right specialists (matching, delivery, HireGlobal, service-offering experts) at the right time.
  • Reporting: Deliver presentations to cross-departmental partners covering metrics, key takeaways, and action plans based on data analysis.
  • Motivation and Recognition: Motivate the team through recognition, incentives, and transparent communication of expectations and results.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal leadership.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our team members, and our story.
  • Become acquainted with the team members who will report to you.

  • Complete Toptal’s leadership/sales training program and build a deep understanding of who our clients are and how Client Advisors sell across our full portfolio.
  • Understand your team and their current performance levels, the SMB Sales Leadership and expectations, and identify the main causes of conversion leakage.
  • Begin 1-1 coaching with each team member based on ongoing live and recorded call reviews.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Develop and roll out your strategy to increase team performance and productivity, with individual goals set for each team member.
  • Run consistent coaching and opportunity-review cadences with specific improvement priorities for each Client Advisor.
  • Deliver your first cross-departmental presentation covering metrics, key takeaways, and action plans.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Demonstrate measurable commercial improvement in conversion and sales performance from Client Advisors being coached, supported by stronger call quality scores, opportunity progression, and qualified HireGlobal and services opportunities.
  • Regularly assess performance against KPIs, partnering with sales enablement and operations to continuously improve.
  • Continue building, coaching, and mentoring your team toward greater results.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Run an optimized, well-managed inbound sales function that maximizes Toptal’s ability to capture SMB market demand profitably.
  • Develop senior Client Advisors who mentor new team members and serve as reference points on discovery quality and portfolio positioning.
  • Sustain a culture of high performance, continuous improvement, and record-breaking results and client experiences.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Three or more years in business-to-business sales, featuring one to two years direct leadership of inbound, inside, or end-to-end small business sales teams.
  • Demonstrated record of improving individual and team sales performance through specific coaching, disciplined opportunity management, and clear performance expectations. Ability to learn and coach to a structured sales methodology.

  • Accountable. You take ownership of your team’s results and hold your team accountable to raising their own bar.
  • Critical thinker. Strong analytical and problem-resolution skills, with a demonstrated ability to develop data-driven solutions.
  • Proactive, collaborative communicator. You drive toward the mission without being told, and you communicate clearly across your team, cross-functional partners, and clients essential in our remote environment.

Job Summary:
Toptal is looking for a Marketing Analyst to build and own the marketing data infrastructure to support new businesses and companies we acquire through M&A. The role is part of our Business Analytics Center of Excellence, where analysts are assigned to support one or more business functions. You will track paid advertising performance and translate it into metrics such as LTV and ROAS that inform budget allocation and channel strategy, from structuring the underlying data pipelines to developing the reports that help marketing and business leaders make data-driven decisions.
Are you passionate about bringing rigor to how early-stage businesses measure and optimize acquisition spend from day one? If so, we encourage you to apply! This person will define the metrics that matter, measure channel and campaign performance, and develop reports that drive decisions. They will also build models, forecast outcomes, run experiments, and perform in-depth diagnostic analysis.
Ultimate success goes beyond data-related activities, you’ll be delivering the “so what” that drives decisions and real business impact. It is imperative to fully understand each business (processes, objectives, organization, performance drivers, barriers), and connect the dots between paid acquisition data, marketing strategy, and financial and operational effectiveness. This role partners closely with the Business Analyst, New Businesses and the Senior Business Analyst focused on acquisitions, ensuring marketing performance insights are integrated with the broader business and revenue picture. We expect that we not only answer the question asked, but also the question that was not.
This Marketing Analyst needs to build positive relationships across the organization, manage diverse stakeholders with competing and often conflicting priorities, and have a “find a way” attitude.
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
Analyze data, build models, test hypotheses, find root causes, develop prototypes, forecast performance, create Tableau reports, and write SQL scripts; and extract insights from these data activities to inform marketing decisions.
Build, own, and maintain the marketing data infrastructure, from ad impression and click through lead acquisition to revenue, setting up and integrating Google Analytics, Google Ads, and other paid advertising platforms as required.
Rapidly assess and integrate the marketing data of newly acquired (M&A) companies, establishing tracking, attribution, and reporting so their acquisition spend is measured with the same rigor as the rest of Toptal.
Measure and diagnose paid advertising performance across channels and businesses—analyzing spend efficiency, CAC, funnel conversion, lead value, ROAS, and LTV—to guide budget allocation and channel strategy.
Define metrics that are independent, holistic, accurate, encourage the right behaviors, and are aligned with company strategy and objectives, including consistent definitions of LTV, ROAS, and payback across businesses.
Use descriptive (what happened) and diagnostic (why did it happen) analytics to develop specific, actionable recommendations for marketing leaders and business owners.
Partner closely with the Business Analyst, New Businesses and the Senior Business Analyst focused on acquisitions to connect marketing performance with revenue, unit economics, and the broader business picture.
Map marketing processes and channel journeys to their corresponding data flows across acquisition, engagement, and revenue generation.
Proactively identify and surface opportunities to improve efficiency, conversion, revenue generation, client and talent experience, operations, communication, systems & tools, cash usage, etc.
Leverage Generative AI tools to accelerate analysis and automate reporting workflows.
In the first week, expect to:
Onboard and integrate into Toptal, quickly learning about Toptal’s history, culture, and vision.
Shadow key teams to learn the core of each new business and its paid acquisition channels.
In the first month, expect to:
Understand the marketing data generated and where/how it is stored, especially as it relates to the Business Analytics team.
Obtain a basic understanding of each business’s paid advertising channels, spend, and operations.
Assess the current state of tracking, attribution, performance metrics, reports, dashboards, and models in use, and identify gaps and discrepancies.
Begin supporting business leaders with relevant paid performance insights and reports for leadership meetings.
In the first three months, expect to:
Develop proficiency in the marketing data elements of each business and obtain a robust understanding of the paid acquisition funnel from ad spend to revenue.
Deliver a first version of the marketing data infrastructure and ROAS/LTV reporting for the new businesses, and gain the ability to assess the drivers and impacts of marketing decisions on financial performance.
Begin identifying new opportunities to explore in the quest to improve performance continually while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
In the first six months, expect to:
Begin to solve real business problems as a team that will move the needle on key marketing performance metrics and financial performance.
Help us align and standardize LTV, ROAS, and other metric definitions across the new businesses and the company.
Perform detailed root cause analysis to expose critical drivers of channel performance, and stand up a repeatable playbook for onboarding the marketing data of newly acquired companies.
In the first year, expect to:
Inform significant strategic initiatives, goals, priorities, and performance indicators, including budget allocation and channel strategy for the new businesses.
Become an expert both on marketing process and data flow, and help build an outstanding marketing analytics function for new businesses and M&A.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree is required.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, analytics, or business intelligence is required, with a focus on marketing analytics.
Demonstrated experience analyzing paid advertising performance (e.g., Google Ads and other paid media platforms) and translating it into metrics such as LTV, CAC, and ROAS is required.
Demonstrated experience building or owning marketing data infrastructure (tracking, attribution, data pipelines, and reporting) is required.
Both a strong background in math, science, finance, engineering, or statistics and deep business insight is required; advanced degrees and/or MBA are a plus.
Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Qlik, PowerBI, etc.).
Proficiency in SQL; experience with R, Python, or MATLAB is a plus.
Hands-on experience using Generative AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT to support analysis, automation, and reporting.
Experience with exploratory data analysis, prototyping, testing hypotheses, performing root cause analyses, modeling business processes, building forecasts, creating predictive models, defining metrics, and/or measuring marketing performance.
Track record of linking data and analytics to marketing strategy, financial performance, and operations to drive real impact.
Working knowledge of probability and statistics, experience with process improvement is a plus.
Experience in a startup, early-stage business, or M&A integration environment is a plus.
Proven ability to manage diverse stakeholders and balance multiple, conflicting priorities in a fast-moving environment.
Ability to explain complex issues simply and intuitively, and willingness to challenge assumptions, communicate limitations, and flag blind spots.
The ideal candidate needs to have a strong technical background particularly when it comes to marketing data infrastructure and Google products (Google Analytics, Google Ads) while having the ability to master marketing processes of diverse nature.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Analyze data, build models, test hypotheses, find root causes, develop prototypes, forecast performance, create Tableau reports, and write SQL scripts; and extract insights from these data activities to inform marketing decisions.

  • Shadow key teams to learn the core of each new business and its paid acquisition channels.

  • Understand the marketing data generated and where/how it is stored, especially as it relates to the Business Analytics team.

  • Develop proficiency in the marketing data elements of each business and obtain a robust understanding of the paid acquisition funnel from ad spend to revenue.
  • Deliver a first version of the marketing data infrastructure and ROAS/LTV reporting for the new businesses, and gain the ability to assess the drivers and impacts of marketing decisions on financial performance.
  • Begin identifying new opportunities to explore in the quest to improve performance continually while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Begin to solve real business problems as a team that will move the needle on key marketing performance metrics and financial performance.
  • Help us align and standardize LTV, ROAS, and other metric definitions across the new businesses and the company.
  • Perform detailed root cause analysis to expose critical drivers of channel performance, and stand up a repeatable playbook for onboarding the marketing data of newly acquired companies.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Inform significant strategic initiatives, goals, priorities, and performance indicators, including budget allocation and channel strategy for the new businesses.
  • Become an expert both on marketing process and data flow, and help build an outstanding marketing analytics function for new businesses and M&A.

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 3+ years of experience in data analysis, analytics, or business intelligence is required, with a focus on marketing analytics.
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing paid advertising performance (e.g., Google Ads and other paid media platforms) and translating it into metrics such as LTV, CAC, and ROAS is required.
  • Demonstrated experience building or owning marketing data infrastructure (tracking, attribution, data pipelines, and reporting) is required.
  • Both a strong background in math, science, finance, engineering, or statistics and deep business insight is required; advanced degrees and/or MBA are a plus.
  • Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Qlik, PowerBI, etc.).
  • Proficiency in SQL; experience with R, Python, or MATLAB is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience using Generative AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT to support analysis, automation, and reporting.
  • Experience with exploratory data analysis, prototyping, testing hypotheses, performing root cause analyses, modeling business processes, building forecasts, creating predictive models, defining metrics, and/or measuring marketing performance.

  • Working knowledge of probability and statistics, experience with process improvement is a plus.
  • Experience in a startup, early-stage business, or M&A integration environment is a plus.
  • Proven ability to manage diverse stakeholders and balance multiple, conflicting priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Ability to explain complex issues simply and intuitively, and willingness to challenge assumptions, communicate limitations, and flag blind spots.
  • The ideal candidate needs to have a strong technical background particularly when it comes to marketing data infrastructure and Google products (Google Analytics, Google Ads) while having the ability to master marketing processes of diverse nature.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Organize and update process guidelines, making them easily accessible for team reference.

Learn team tools, processes, and reporting mechanisms.
Gain proficiency with Toptal’s platform.

Understand team processes, policies, and content repository.
Familiarize yourself with various teams at Toptal and their contributions to company success.
Begin executing tasks with support from other team members.

Independently execute various tasks and actions associated with assigned accounts based on defined processes.

By having a full grasp of the role, start making your own contributions to our strategies, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
Be an integral part of the Matching team’s success.

Act as a subject matter expert on the Matching Operations Coordinator role.

Excellent written and oral communication and stakeholder management skills. Good communication is at the core of everything we do. Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail. You are highly organized, know how to work efficiently, and prioritize execution.
You should be a self-starter who thrives on accountability and managing your own workflow, tasks, and assigned accounts.
Ability to work independently at a high professional level. You are expected to take ownership of your responsibilities, manage your workload effectively, exercise sound judgment, and maintain a high standard of professionalism with limited supervision.
You need to be able to follow processes expertly. When faced with limited data, you need to be able to make decisions that follow given guidelines.
Adaptability. Our processes and priorities may evolve rapidly. You need to be able to learn and adapt to change quickly.
Willingness to collaborate, share knowledge, and learn from teammates.
Proficiency in Google Sheets and Google Docs for data processing and presentation.
Data analysis and data-driven decision-making. Experience analyzing operational data, identifying trends, and translating data into actionable insights is a plus.
Continuous Improvement. You proactively identify opportunities to improve processes, increase efficiency, and use data and feedback to inform better ways of working.

Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

You will set the stage for successful sales interactions through cold outreach efforts and nurturing relationships to secure qualified meetings for our sales team. If you’re a self-motivated individual with a passion for sales, we encourage you to join our team!

Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
Sales: Understand current and future demand. Enable, educate, and directly support the sales force to best position this practice with Toptal clients and win new business. Lead client conversations, presenting Toptal’s perspective on innovation and experience topics, and ask exploratory questions to better understand client needs.
Begin the Relationship: Through lead-generation activities and cold-calling, you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop sales-ready leads and opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts. You will enthusiastically explain Toptal’s vision, pinpoint opportunities, and generate interest.
Client and Industry Knowledge: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. As the first point of contact for future Enterprise and SMB clients, you will be building rapport through strategic outreach and a well-rounded client and industry knowledge. Researching clients and staying informed on industry trends will be key to your success.
Collaborate with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team and Staffing Sales Executive to pursue opportunities, recommend appropriate follow-up actions, and schedule qualified meetings. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
Growth and Development: Our team has an aversion to complacency. We are always looking to improve both individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical success factors in this role and at Toptal. As you become more comfortable in the role, you will help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics.
In the first week, expect to:
Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
Work with cross-functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success.
Learn the breadth of Toptal’s impact on the world’s largest companies.
Grasp the importance of the SDR function to the success of Toptal.
Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.
In the first month, expect to:
Complete our personalized sales training program with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios.
Learn how to use Salesforce.com (our CRM) and other SaaS outreach tools (ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).
Integrate into your pod, partner with Staffing Sales Executives and Staffing Sales Leadership, and begin targeting strategic accounts.
Learn the process for outreach, including calling, emailing, and LinkedIn messaging. Implement an outreach process and hit 1-month objectives.
Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers.
In the first three months, expect to:
Become fully ramped on the SDR team, attaining your metrics, which include calls, emails, and other sales activities.
Exercising discretion and independent judgment, uncover new opportunities within existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal.
Hit call/email quotas and fully ramped objectives.
Become proficient in using our SaaS tools.
Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com.
In the first six months, expect to:
Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives.
Assist with training and onboarding new SDRs.
Build new and existing client relationships, expand Toptal’s partnerships, and continue to execute account plans.
Suggest, implement, and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities.
In the first year, expect to:
Have built a portfolio of net new accounts from the strategic account list.
Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and how proper sales development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree is required.
1-3 years of experience as an Enterprise SDR within the Staffing industry or related Staffing verticals.
Knowledgeable. Broad understanding of business challenges encountered by Enterprise clients across key staffing verticals, including Manufacturing, Logistics & Distribution, Industrial, Engineering, Healthcare, E-commerce & Retail, and Skilled Trades.
Critical thinking. Critically think through the challenges clients face to create new opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts.
Perseverance. Be relentless and push towards your goal.
Passion. Enthusiasm and ambition to succeed in this role, as it can be difficult if you hate rejection.
Curiosity. A desire to understand people, their problems, their companies, and their industries.
Conscientiousness. We’re not doing a simple SaaS sale, so discussions may get technical. Understanding sophisticated issues and explaining them to clients is important.
Motivated. Be highly motivated and continuously strive for personal and professional improvement.
Resourceful. Think about target accounts as your own business - we want self-starters who are passionate about hunting for new accounts, and who thrive with the freedom and accountability of leading their portion of the business.
Proactive. Understand our mission and do the work required to drive us to that goal, by following a process and being creative.
Communication. You must exhibit outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Communication is the lifeblood of both internal and external relationships. Demonstrate excellent communication in all forms, across a wide variety of personality types, roles, and geographies.
Team. Nothing we do is done in isolation. Success depends on your ability to work as a team both within Toptal and within your client accounts.
Ownership. Exhibit ownership of accounts, successes, and failures.
Problem Solver. Life throws in minor challenges beyond the primary problems this role is meant to solve. You must have the ability to take those in stride and persist despite setbacks.
Prioritization. The nature of this role requires that you understand the priorities and timelines associated with each of your accounts and execute appropriately with those in mind.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Job Summary
Toptal’s Marketing Agency Organization spans eight practices, from brand and advertising to martech and content marketing. We need a hybrid operator across solution architecture, sales enablement, partnerships, and client-facing business development — judged on outcomes: deals won, partner revenue generated, offerings shipped.
You will be part of a distributed team and will be reporting directly to our Practice Director of our Marketing Agency.
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
Solution Architecture & Enterprise Deal Support
Lead proposals and RFP responses for large, complex Enterprise engagements, and partner directly with SMB and Enterprise sales teams earlier in the deal cycle as a solutions counterpart and marketing subject matter expert.
Partnerships & Go-to-Market
Own go-to-market execution of strategic partnerships with organizations like Hawke Media and Writer — offer structure, pricing, and co-sell motions — and be accountable for converting them into real, measurable revenue.
Core Offering Development
Help evolve the core service catalog across project-based professional services and fully managed / retainer models, packaged so they’re easy for Sales to sell and clients to buy.
Client-Facing Business Development
Represent the organization directly with prospective and existing Enterprise clients, owning outcomes and generating new business rather than only supporting from behind the scenes.
AI Enablement
Design AI-enabled offerings for clients, and champion practical AI adoption inside the team.
In the first week, expect to:
Meet the team.
Familiarize yourself with Toptal’s operations, including OKRs, RACIs, and other operational frameworks.
Undergo role-specific training to understand the procedures and tools currently utilized within our Marketing Agency Organization.
In the first month, expect to:
Get to know your set of key stakeholders, both internally among the sales and operational teams at Toptal, as well as within our talent network, partners, and clients.
Support the development of sales support material for our core marketing services offerings, assist sales counterparts on client calls, and help build RFPs and proposals that drive revenue for the business.
In the first three months, expect to:
Evolve and formalize our go-to-market motion through a blend of direct sales activities, RFP and proposal responses, marketing campaigns, partnership co-sell and referral programs, and other techniques we haven’t thought of yet.
Use your agency and client experience to build strong, trusted relationships across our internal sales and marketing teams as well as our key clients and talent network.
In the first six months, expect to:
Build a whole new set of offerings for Toptal’s Marketing Agency, helping evolve the organization to a full-fledged professional and managed services organization.
Bring new AI tools, processes, and approaches to the table that improve upon our existing approach, but most importantly drive pipeline and revenue.
In the first year, expect to:
Become an integral part of the Toptal Marketing Agency team.
Contribute to substantial year-over-year growth for Toptal, supporting new client acquisition activities across SMB, mid-market, and Enterprise clients.
Qualifications and Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree.
8+ years of agency and/or consulting background with a track record of owning outcomes and working directly with clients.
Experience writing and leading proposals or RFP responses for deals of varying size and complexity.
Partnerships experience — building GTM motions and joint offerings that generated real, measurable revenue.
Comfort working across both B2B and B2C, and across verticals such as consumer goods, technology, insurance, and financial services.
Genuine interest in AI: designing AI-enabled client solutions and upskilling an internal team on AI tools.
Experience working across various parts of the modern GTM motion: marketing, sales, customer success, revops.
Strong client-facing presence, energized by business development, with excellent communication skills.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, as well as perfect grammar and command of the English language.
Ability to communicate clearly and consistently with teams through collaboration tools such as Slack.
Demonstrated ability to excel as an individual contributor and deliver exceptional results.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Work independently with minimal supervision.
Use all required digital collaboration tools.
Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Position Description:
As SVP, Product, you will shape the vision as to where Toptal’s products and platforms go next and then drive the execution to build them. This is the most senior product role in the company. You will report to the Chief Executive Officer, sit on the executive team, and work collaboratively with our Engineering, Design, Finance, Marketing, New Businesses, Professional Services, and Customer leaders. AI is not a line item on your roadmap. It is the roadmap.
You should be Toptal’s foremost expert on what AI means for products and platforms. That means real depth in fine-tuning and post-training, agent design and evaluation, and the economics of running models in production, along with the judgment to know which applies to us. Work directly with our AI researchers rather than through them. We expect both the AI agenda and the product strategy to originate with you. We will react to your plan rather than hand you ours.
This is a hands-on role. You will write your own specs and pull your own data. When you think an agent could take over a piece of work, you will build a rough version and find out whether it holds up before anyone budgets for it. You will sit in product reviews and say what you actually think. We move fast, and we need Product setting the pace. You will own and set the standards for the hiring bar for the product team, bringing in talent that will advance Toptal to the next level.
Your remit runs across the business: the core platform, the talent and client experiences, the internal systems that run it, the products we take to market, and the data and AI platform underneath them. You will work hand in hand with Engineering on the platform all of it runs on, fold acquisitions and new products into the portfolio, and know growth marketing cold, because how a product reaches the market is part of building it.
Product is yours to shape at blazing speed: scoping, sizing the teams, planning headcount, and defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing them off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about landing an A player and treats an open seat as urgent. Your own dedication and hard work will set the tone, and the people you bring in should be inspired to do the best work of their careers on this team. We are looking for the person who will define what an AI-native product organization looks like and then run it successfully.
This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
AI and agentic product
Own Toptal’s AI product strategy: where agents and models belong across the marketplace, the talent and client experiences, our internal systems, and the products we take to market, along with the business outcomes they carry.
Decide what we build with AI and what we do not, including build-versus-buy on models and tooling and the packaging and pricing of AI-enabled products.
Make AI quality measurable through evals, acceptance bars, and review loops, and partner with Engineering on the platform as its most demanding customer.
Rebuild how Product works using AI, raising the output and judgment of every product manager through AI-assisted discovery, research, prototyping, and analysis. Product managers have to want this rather than comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.
Portfolio and operating model
Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for the whole portfolio: what we build, what we sunset, and how investment is distributed across growth, platform, and operational leverage.
Establish the product operating model and the metrics behind it, so decisions are made on evidence and user research rather than opinion.
Own the product integration of acquisitions and new products, and act as a senior voice of the customer for both talent and clients.
Team and accountability
Decide what a product team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.
Own resourcing and workforce planning, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.
Review the product work directly, develop people against a clear bar, and raise it as the organization grows.
In the first week, expect to:
Work to get up to speed with how the organization runs, including how our operational frameworks work.
Begin building relationships with the CEO, the executive team, and your direct reports.
Begin learning Toptal’s platform architecture, marketplace dynamics, internal tooling, and current AI initiatives and capabilities.
In the first month, expect to:
Assess the current state of the Product organization and its AI maturity: its people, its roadmap, its rituals, and where the gaps are, including the team against the bar this role requires.
Bring the executive team a product strategy no one asked you for.
Become acquainted with the full product portfolio, the company’s goals, and those you will partner with.
Establish a shared view with the CEO and the executive team of the company’s priorities and how product supports them.
Start collaborating closely with your product teams.
In the first three months, expect to:
Own the product portfolio, its strategy, and its roadmap, and be executing your own plan with at least one AI-enabled capability already in production and measured.
Present your resourcing plan and a clear point of view to the executive team on where product investment should concentrate, what should be deprioritized, and why.
Establish or refine the product operating model: planning cadence, prioritization framework, and the metrics the organization will be held to, with the trust of the peers and teams you work with most closely.
In the first six months, expect to:
Show business impact from AI-enabled products in at least two core surfaces, with the evidence behind it, and visible progress against the top portfolio priorities measured against the metrics you defined.
Have the right leadership team in place, with a clear plan to close any remaining gaps.
Be inspiring and mentoring the teams you work with, upleveling how the organization brainstorms, collaborates, and executes, and charting a clear path for scaling Product’s impact.
In the first year, expect to:
Run a product organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with AI leverage embedded in the portfolio and the operating model rather than living in a set of pilots.
Have built an exceptional product team doing the best work of their careers, with a record of building impactful products in a timely and elegant fashion.
Deliver on your roadmap priorities and promises, with a demonstrable link between product investment and business results, and Product established as a trusted, high-leverage function that the rest of the company plans around.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree is required, preferably in a technical discipline (Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems). Masters is strongly preferred.
At least 15 years of proven software Product Management experience.
At least 8 years of experience leading Product organizations, including experience leading other product leaders (managing managers).
Proven ability to raise the level of a product organization through the people you hire and develop.
Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, with a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.
Experience owning an entire product portfolio at a high-growth technology company, with accountability for business outcomes and not solely delivery.
Demonstrated success setting product strategy at the executive level and translating it into an executable roadmap across multiple teams and domains.
Experience leading AI-enabled products, with a focus on delivering measurable business outcomes.
Deep, hands-on command of modern AI as a product discipline: agentic architectures, harness and orchestration design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation, along with the economics of running models in production. You have shipped these yourself.
Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.
Growth marketing fluency. You understand acquisition, activation, conversion, and retention well enough to build for them.
Experience with marketplace, platform, or two-sided business models is a strong plus.
Prior experience working as a Software Engineer is a strong plus.
Comfortable working with SQL or spreadsheets to analyze data, as well as conducting research with internal and external users.
Ability to creatively craft solutions through data and a user-centric approach.
Be meticulous and have a high bar for quality when writing user stories, brainstorming technical approaches, and testing a feature before it is released.
Be humble, willing to learn, and do whatever is needed to help us accomplish our goals.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Experience using agile development methodologies with globally distributed teams and the ability to keep up with a fast-paced and global company.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal, and you will not be here just to tell other people what to do.
